information.description:
Distant heir to the old Wiseman and the strongest netrunning body ever built. It breaks firewalls at extreme range, at a ruinous price in money and sanity. Raven learned the hard way what happens to a Sage pilot without therapy.

Cost: 38,250eb
Humanity Loss: 73 ([1d6/2 Round Up] + 21d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: MonoVision
Base chrome (no HL): (+1 Cyberdeck Slot) Cybersuite
Chrome: Bioconductor, C-Link Socket, Cyberdeck Cyberarm Option ×2, FBC Integrated Bodyweight Coating ×3, Integrated Cyberdeck Upgrade ×4, Integrated Netstation, Integrated Zetatech CyberConductor, Memory Boost (w/ Speedy Gonzalvez), RAM Upgrade ×2, Scrambler Descrambler, Self-ICE (w/ Firewall Port [w/ Raven Black ICE]) ×2

Note: Fitting one includes 4 weeks of Intensive Therapy (cost and Humanity already counted); skip it and you come out a psychotic wreck.

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.
